title: Code and data for the article "How do you feel? Direct valence measurement enables the detection of affect shift dynamics as powerful predictors of psychological well-being"
description: Analysis code (R) and the three ecological momentary assessment datasets (German study, Spanish studies 1 and 2; N = 345) used in Goicoechea and Perakakis (2026), Affective Science. The code is released under the MIT licence and the data under CC BY 4.0; see LICENSE and data/LICENSE.md in the archive.
